## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

**1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?**
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 6/11 sectors positive. Leadership: Narrow (Top 5 concentrated in Communication and Technology), style mixed / no clear leadership; major divergence noted among large caps, so defer strong directional calls.

**2. Which sectors are leading?**
Communication leads: VZ (1W: +12.59% | 1M: +11.43%) ABOVE TREND, T (1W: +12.15% | 1M: +7.12%) ABOVE TREND, CHTR (1W: +10.23% | 1M: +2.33%) ABOVE TREND — Sector breadth: Communication 5/7 positive. Consumer Staples strong: CL (1W: +7.85% | 1M: +17.00%) ABOVE TREND, PEP (1W: +6.40% | 1M: +8.14%) ABOVE TREND — Sector breadth: Consumer Staples 8/12 positive. Industrials follow: FDX (1W: +10.13% | 1M: +16.08%) ABOVE TREND, CAT (1W: +8.65% | 1M: +20.89%) ABOVE TREND — Sector breadth: Industrials 9/13 positive.

**3. Which sectors are lagging?**
Technology lagging with several megacaps under pressure: MSFT (1W: -9.97% | 1M: -12.46%) BELOW TREND, CRM (1W: -8.10% | 1M: -20.42%) BELOW TREND, ORCL (1W: -12.27% | 1M: -17.66%) BELOW TREND — Sector breadth: Technology 7/19 positive. Healthcare weak: UNH (1W: -18.78% | 1M: -13.49%) BELOW TREND, CVS (1W: -10.08% | 1M: -4.18%) BELOW TREND — Sector breadth: Healthcare 6/15 positive. Materials mixed/soft: NEM (1W: -10.38% | 1M: +13.02%) CORRECTION — Sector breadth: Materials 3/7 positive.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

**4. Top Performing Stocks?**
Top 5: TXN (1W: +15.20% | 1M: +30.54%) ABOVE TREND, INTC (1W: +14.87% | 1M: +32.28%) ABOVE TREND, VZ (1W: +12.59% | 1M: +11.43%) ABOVE TREND, T (1W: +12.15% | 1M: +7.12%) ABOVE TREND, CHTR (1W: +10.23% | 1M: +2.33%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Narrow (3/5 Communication, 2/5 Technology); concentration warrants selectivity.

**5. Worst Performing Stocks?**
Bottom 5: TMO (1W: -7.16% | 1M: +0.40%) CORRECTION, PYPL (1W: -7.54% | 1M: -10.36%) BELOW TREND, CRM (1W: -8.10% | 1M: -20.42%) BELOW TREND, MSFT (1W: -9.97% | 1M: -12.46%) BELOW TREND, UNH (1W: -18.78% | 1M: -13.49%) BELOW TREND — Weakness concentrated in large-cap tech and healthcare.

**6. Momentum Stocks?**
Strongest 1W movers: TXN (1W: +15.20% | 1M: +30.54%) ABOVE TREND, INTC (1W: +14.87% | 1M: +32.28%) ABOVE TREND, VZ (1W: +12.59% | 1M: +11.43%) ABOVE TREND, T (1W: +12.15% | 1M: +7.12%) ABOVE TREND, FDX (1W: +10.13% | 1M: +16.08%) ABOVE TREND. Watch AAPL (1W: +5.72% | 1M: -0.68%) RECOVERY and JPM (1W: +2.36% | 1M: -3.94%) RECOVERY as divergence candidates.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Technology Outlook?**
Mixed and under pressure; leadership localized to chip suppliers while cloud/software names are weak. TXN (1W: +15.20% | 1M: +30.54%) ABOVE TREND and INTC (1W: +14.87% | 1M: +32.28%) ABOVE TREND contrast with MSFT (1W: -9.97% | 1M: -12.46%) BELOW TREND, CRM (1W: -8.10% | 1M: -20.42%) BELOW TREND — Sector breadth: Technology 7/19 positive.

**8. Financials Outlook?**
Financials show selective strength but mixed internals; JPM (1W: +2.36% | 1M: -3.94%) RECOVERY and V (1W: +1.63% | 1M: -4.81%) RECOVERY signal short-term improvement while PYPL (1W: -7.54% | 1M: -10.36%) BELOW TREND flags idiosyncratic risk — Sector breadth: Financials 11/20 positive.

**9. Healthcare Outlook?**
Healthcare soft with dispersion: JNJ (1W: +4.18% | 1M: +11.50%) ABOVE TREND and PFE (1W: +3.01% | 1M: +8.86%) ABOVE TREND versus UNH (1W: -18.78% | 1M: -13.49%) BELOW TREND and LLY (1W: -1.75% | 1M: -2.84%) BELOW TREND — Sector breadth: Healthcare 6/15 positive.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**
Neutral stance: favor selective exposure to Communication, Industrials and Consumer Staples names showing ABOVE TREND strength (VZ, CAT, CL) and reduce exposure to stretched cloud/software large caps showing BELOW TREND (MSFT, CRM, ORCL, INTU, NOW). Monitor RECOVERY signals in AAPL (1W: +5.72% | 1M: -0.68%) RECOVERY and JPM (1W: +2.36% | 1M: -3.94%) RECOVERY for confirmation before re-sizing.

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: TXN (1W: +15.20% | 1M: +30.54%) ABOVE TREND, INTC (1W: +14.87% | 1M: +32.28%) ABOVE TREND, CAT (1W: +8.65% | 1M: +20.89%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: MSFT (1W: -9.97% | 1M: -12.46%) BELOW TREND, CRM (1W: -8.10% | 1M: -20.42%) BELOW TREND, ORCL (1W: -12.27% | 1M: -17.66%) BELOW TREND.

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: Communication (Breadth: Communication 5/7 positive), Industrials (Breadth: Industrials 9/13 positive), Consumer Staples (Breadth: Consumer Staples 8/12 positive). BEARISH: Technology (Breadth: Technology 7/19 positive), Healthcare (Breadth: Healthcare 6/15 positive), Materials (Breadth: Materials 3/7 positive).

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**
Monitor TXN and INTC for continuation above recent breakout ranges to confirm chip-led momentum and broaden leadership. Watch MSFT and CRM break/hold below this week's lows as triggers that deepen tech weakness. Use AAPL and JPM RECOVERY confirmations (sustained weekly follow-through) as tactical entry signals for reflation exposure.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

**14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?**
XOM (+75): The bullish headline on buybacks and output aligns with price XOM (1W: +2.64% | 1M: +15.01%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment confirmed. CRM (+65): Army deal headline but CRM (1W: -8.10% | 1M: -20.42%) BELOW TREND — sentiment diverging, distribution risk. VZ (+60): Subscriber strength and VZ (1W: +12.59% | 1M: +11.43%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment confirmed. PYPL (+50): Positive quarterly notes but PYPL (1W: -7.54% | 1M: -10.36%) BELOW TREND — follow-through required.

**15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?**
ORCL (-50): Price action ORCL (1W: -12.27% | 1M: -17.66%) BELOW TREND confirms analyst-negative headlines. JPM (-50): Headline risk while JPM (1W: +2.36% | 1M: -3.94%) RECOVERY shows divergence between news and price; monitor for volatility.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL regime, style mixed / no clear leadership. TXN (1W: +15.20% | 1M: +30.54%) ABOVE TREND, INTC (1W: +14.87% | 1M: +32.28%) ABOVE TREND and VZ (1W: +12.59% | 1M: +11.43%) ABOVE TREND are showing relative strength. Key risk is major divergence among large caps (AAPL RECOVERY, JPM RECOVERY vs MSFT/CRM/ORCL BELOW TREND) and mixed sentiment signals that could broaden volatility.
